isolation: Controller inspected actual calls: only authorized plan/reader, in-memory candidate construction, pinned checkers, holders and cleanup. Protocol isolation, not an operating-system sandbox. No peer output, score, outside-source, credential or paid-service access.
blindReading: Both plans and complete lossless readers authenticated before authoring; initial invalid zero-based reader calls corrected without missing content.

blindUnsavedCorrections.nature: Bounded definition/source-context and internal consistency corrections. No decision outcome prescribed and no other reviewer opinion disclosed. Complete rejected bytes and retirement evidence preserved.

transportQualifications: Pass A used a PTY for the first checker despite the no-PTY instruction; session 54590 exited 0. Subsequent exact UTF-8 non-PTY checker and holder authenticate the actual reviewed bytes.

Pass B initially used invalid decision enums accept/reject; pinned checker rejected them, then same context normalized to accepted/rejected. The original in-memory authoring source and exact diagnostics are preserved as inert audit data.
executionCountMeaning: Generic execution retries=0 means no new context or saved-submission retry; it does not erase the explicitly recorded unsaved corrections.

adjudication.qualification: One rejection rationale added a sole-ground requirement absent from the exact definition. Neutral same-context feedback prompted independent reconsideration of that single candidate. No outcome prescribed; other 20 decisions mechanically unchanged. Rejected bytes and holder retirement retained.
